# from a source YaTool build configuration provided in ya.make files.

# If the repository supports both CMake and ya build configurations, please modify both of them.
#
# If only CMake build configuration is supported then modify only CMake files and note that only
# simple modifications are allowed like adding source-files to targets or adding simple properties
# like target_include_directories. These modifications will be ported to original ya.make files
# by maintainers. Any complex modifications which can't be easily ported back to the ya build
# system may be rejected.

# Please refer to the build instructions in the repository for more information about manual
# changes in this file.

add_library(cpp-cuda-wrappers)

if (HAVE_ROCM)
  if(${CMAKE_VERSION} VERSION_LESS "3.17.0")
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Build with HIP requires at least cmake 3.17.0")
  endif()

  enable_language(HIP)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -D__HIP_PLATFORM_AMD__")

  find_package(HIP REQUIRED)
  target_include_directories(cpp-cuda-wrappers PRIVATE ${HIP_INCLUDE_DIRS})
endif()

if (HAVE_ROCM)
  # ROCm/HIP build: skip libcxxsupp (clang uses system libc++).
  target_link_libraries(cpp-cuda-wrappers PUBLIC
    contrib-libs-linux-headers
    yutil
    internal-platform-cuda
    cpp-cuda-exception
    cpp-threading-future
  )
else()
  # CUDA build: keep libcxxsupp.
  target_link_libraries(cpp-cuda-wrappers PUBLIC
    contrib-libs-linux-headers
    contrib-libs-cxxsupp
    yutil
    internal-platform-cuda
    cpp-cuda-exception
    cpp-threading-future
  )
endif()

set(WRAPPER_CPP_SOURCES
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/library/cpp/cuda/wrappers/base.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/library/cpp/cuda/wrappers/run_gpu_program.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/library/cpp/cuda/wrappers/cuda_event.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/library/cpp/cuda/wrappers/arch.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/library/cpp/cuda/wrappers/stream_pool.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/library/cpp/cuda/wrappers/cuda_vec.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/library/cpp/cuda/wrappers/cuda_graph.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/library/cpp/cuda/wrappers/stream_capture.cpp
)

target_sources(cpp-cuda-wrappers PRIVATE ${WRAPPER_CPP_SOURCES})

# For ROCm builds: libcxxcuda11 is not linked, so no special handling needed
# The system C++ library will be used automatically

target_cuda_sources(cpp-cuda-wrappers PRIVATE
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/library/cpp/cuda/wrappers/kernel.cu
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/library/cpp/cuda/wrappers/kernel_helpers.cu
)

if (NOT HAVE_ROCM)
target_cuda_flags(cpp-cuda-wrappers
  -lineinfo
  --use_fast_math
  -Wno-deprecated-gpu-targets
)
endif()
